title: Slice Filter, Deprecated Search Removal, and SDK Consumption
mini_srs: Introduces the SliceCondition filter for deterministic id-space sampling (55cf6b7 in qdrant_common.proto) and removes the deprecated Search, Recommend, and Discover REST endpoints from the OpenAPI spec while marking the corresponding gRPC RPCs deprecated (73e6c16 in points_service.proto). The rust-client v1.19 sync (3631300) brings both contract changes plus builder updates for slice and IDF corpus, and 5ffa732 adds #[deprecated] annotations to 8 search/recommend/discover wrapper methods in the Rust SDK. The Python client consumes the changes through the v1.19.0 model update (589aece), adds local-mode validation for min_should/min_count to match server rejection semantics (693c6a3 in payload_filters.py), fixes the slice error message off-by-one (e4e44a7), and pins the keyword prefix round-trip behavior over gRPC (9a01291 in conversion.py). The de3c432 commit extends local-mode text/phrase matching to use token-aware semantics, bridging a congruence gap exposed by CI testing.
expansion_rationale: Hard xrepo edges 55cf6b7->693c6a3 (conf 1.0), 73e6c16->5ffa732 (conf 1.0), and 55cf6b7->5ffa732 (conf 0.85) force all four seeds into one proposal. Path completeness requires 3631300 (55cf6b7->3631300->5ffa732 in rust-client), 589aece (73e6c16->589aece->de3c432->693c6a3 in qdrant-client), and de3c432 (textual path from 589aece to 693c6a3 in payload_filters.py). Patches confirm: 55cf6b7 adds SliceCondition to qdrant_common.proto, 73e6c16 deprecates 8 RPCs in points_service.proto, 5ffa732 adds #[deprecated] to search.rs wrappers, 693c6a3 adds validate_filter() in payload_filters.py consuming the slice condition, e4e44a7 fixes slice error bounds, 9a01291 documents prefix round-trip in conversion.py. Validated with analyze_milestone_conflicts: conflict_count=0.

title: Keyword Index Prefix Matching
mini_srs: Adds an opt-in prefix matching option to keyword payload indexes in the qdrant gRPC API. A new KeywordPrefixParams message in collections.proto and a prefix variant in the Match oneof in qdrant_common.proto enable efficient byte-wise prefix filtering over keyword values for use cases such as URL prefix filtering and facet-based autocompletion. The conversions in conversions.rs map between the gRPC and internal representations, and qdrant.rs is regenerated. SDK consumption occurs through the v1.19 sync commits (3631300, 589aece) in other milestones.
expansion_rationale: Seed 2573869 is a standalone layer-0 contract change (+37-7 across 4 files: conversions.rs, collections.proto, qdrant_common.proto, qdrant.rs). Its direct SDK consumers (9a01291 for Python prefix round-trip fix, 3631300 for Rust client sync) require the mega-sync commits 589aece and 3631300 as path intermediaries, which are already claimed by Proposal 1. Including 2573869 in Proposal 1 would pull in ad3abf7 (G02) and bedab3c (G06) via textual qdrant paths 2573869->ad3abf7->3631300 and 2573869->bedab3c->589aece. Keeping it separate avoids cross-group contamination. Validated with analyze_milestone_conflicts: conflict_count=0.
